response.justification: The candidate is an experienced full-stack and web/mobile software engineer with strong general software craftsmanship skills, but has no demonstrated background in SoC/IP modeling, hardware-software co-design, AI accelerator architecture, GPU/SIMD/MIMD systems, or deep-learning workload optimization. His experience is almost entirely in web platforms, backend services, and product engineering, which does not align with the hardware/performance architecture focus of this principal-level role.
strengths: Extensive senior/staff-level software engineering experience across many domains
Strong track record of technical leadership, mentoring, and workshops
Experience with low-latency, high-performance systems (Dlang, async I/O, fibers) at Dunnhumby
concerns: No evidence of SoC/IP modeling or hardware architecture experience
No AI/deep-learning workload optimization or GPU architecture background
No hardware-software co-design or chip design collaboration experience

key_factors.factor: No AI/DL workload or GPU optimization background
